newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates steady, close at 21.625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates steady, close at 21.625 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates remained near Tuesday's levels, moving in a narrow range close to 21.5 percent, dealers said.
Overnight rates ended at 21.625 percent, compared with Tuesday's close and levels around 21.5 percent.
"The rates were more or less the same as yesterday," said Postabank's Karoly Barath, adding overnight rates were unlikely to move much this week.
Commerzbank's Sandor Tolonics added that a few deals struck above Tuesday's levels may indicate a slight rise later this week to a maximum 22 percent.
He said some of the banks may need money to fill reserves by the end of the two-week reserve period on Saturday, and this may push the rates up slightly.
